name: Image Toolkit
tagline: A fast, offline, open-source image editor — crop, color, retouch, filters, layers, batch and export. No cloud, no AI strings attached.
description: Image Toolkit is a local, offline image editor and batch processor. It covers the everyday and the advanced: crop/rotate/flip/resize/canvas/perspective, full color and tone controls (curves, levels, white balance, HSL, exposure, highlights/shadows), retouching (classical heal/inpaint spot & object removal, red-eye, skin smoothing, denoise, sharpen), non-destructive layers with blend modes and masks, filters and effects (blur, vignette, film looks, .cube LUTs, pencil/stylize), annotation, panorama stitching, HDR merge, focus stacking, content-aware (seam-carve) scaling, RAW loading, and full batch pipelines. Exports JPEG/PNG/WebP/TIFF with presets and metadata control. Built on permissive open-source libraries (Pillow, NumPy, OpenCV, scikit-image, rawpy); nothing is uploaded anywhere.
aiStack: Python (tkinter GUI + CLI), Pillow, NumPy, OpenCV, scikit-image, rawpy
